title: Apple's First Touchscreen MacBook Is Here
description:
Apple just unveiled its first MacBook with a touchscreen: a new MacBook Pro with a tandem OLED display and the Dynamic Island.
It starts at $2,899 ($400 more than the non-touch model); preorders are open and it arrives November 6.
